material.head: Fear day: Fri Oct 23
material.text: Fri Oct 23: SPY and AZZ both closed red, the kind of day the desk's fear-day rule buys.

material.head: A shakeout that failed (spring)
material.text: On Oct 16 it broke under the floor of its trading range and closed back inside: sellers were flushed out, a Wyckoff spring.

material.head: A lower high and a lower low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.

material.head: Resistance +0.2% above
material.text: The nearest ceiling is +0.2% above (right at the close), where 5 levels of 2 kinds meet: the Jul 9 low, the 50-week average and the Sep 1 low: little room before sellers have stepped in before.

material.head: A possible double bottom
material.text: It bottomed twice at the same level (Sep 21 and Oct 16); a close above the peak between them confirms the double bottom.
